name: netstat
description: The legacy tool for network connections, routing tables, and interface statistics — superseded by ss and ip.

flags.description: The classic combo: TCP+UDP, listening, numeric, with programs.

examples.explanation: Same information as ss -tulpn in the older format.
Retransmission statistics — rising values indicate network quality problems.

about: netstat is part of the unmaintained net-tools package. It remains on many systems for muscle memory, but ss covers everything with better performance and more filters. Linux distributions increasingly omit net-tools by default.
useCases: Working on older servers where habits and scripts use it.
mistakes: Installing net-tools just for netstat when ss is already present.
warnings: Deprecated on Linux; do not use in new scripts.
distroNotes: net-tools package; absent by default on many modern minimal installs.
